# ContactRecorderHandle

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/humanbot_formulas.cpp`](../../../src/logic/agents/humanbot_formulas.cpp) · Described in `data/agents_humanbot.json`

Holds the Jolt contact impulse listener of EnergyFormulas and the reports of the step.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `recorder` | `std::shared_ptr<ContactRecorder>` | A JPH::ContactImpulseListener (patched Jolt) whose reports vector gathers every OnContactSolved of the step. |

## Notes

Private to humanbot_formulas.cpp (anonymous namespace). Created by EnergyFormulas on its first eval tick, set as the world's contact impulse listener and never removed; the reports are cleared every tick.
